Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFPadesSigner

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFPadesSigner
public final class CPDFPadesSigner extends Object
Creates PKCS#12 PAdES signatures and prolongs LTV evidence in saved PDF files.

Initialize the SDK before calling. Operations are synchronous and may fetch timestamps, certificates and revocation evidence; run them on a worker thread. Save document edits first and keep input files unchanged during an operation. These entry points do not accept a PDF-open password.

Outputs use distinct new paths whose parent directories already exist. Earlier completed stages may remain available if a later stage fails. Inspect CPDFPadesResult.isSuccess(), CPDFPadesResult.isTargetProfileSatisfied() and the complete validation report before accepting the requested profile.

  • Method Details

    • sign

      public static CPDFPadesResult sign(String source, String signed, String ltv, String lta, CPDFPadesOptions options)
      Creates a new signature field and produces the requested PAdES baseline stages.

      All profiles require a PKCS#12 signer and a signed-stage output. T, LT and LTA require a signature TSA URL. LT/LTA also collect certificate and revocation evidence into DSS/VRI; LTA adds a document timestamp. Configure trust anchors and reachable evidence sources through CPDFPadesOptions.

      Used output paths must be distinct from each other and from the input, must not already exist, and must have existing writable parent directories. A path in the result confirms a completed output stage, not its validation status.

      Parameters:
      source - the readable source PDF path
      signed - the required signed-stage output path for every profile
      ltv - the required LT-stage output path for LT/LTA; unused for B/T and may be null
      lta - the required final output path for LTA; unused for other profiles and may be null
      options - the signing, evidence and TSA settings; null uses defaults, which have no signing certificate
      Returns:
      stage paths, process diagnostics and validation results, including completed stages on partial failure

    • prolongLtv

      public static CPDFPadesResult prolongLtv(String input, String ltv, String lta, CPDFPadesOptions options)
      Adds or refreshes DSS/VRI evidence in an already signed PDF by incremental update.

      This does not create a new approval signature or add a missing embedded signature timestamp. The existing signature must already meet the prerequisites for the desired LT/LTA level. Evidence must validate at the time selected by the validator; collecting newer evidence alone may not validate an older signature.

      CPDFPadesOptions.setAppendDocumentTimestamp(boolean) controls whether a document timestamp is appended and the target is LTA instead of LT. The signing profile, PKCS#12 credentials and appearance settings do not select this operation's target. Used outputs follow the same new-path requirements as sign(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFPadesOptions).

      Parameters:
      input - the readable, already signed PDF path
      ltv - the required output path after DSS/VRI evidence is written
      lta - the required output path when appending a document timestamp; otherwise unused and may be null
      options - LTV collection and document-timestamp settings; null uses defaults targeting LT
      Returns:
      the prolongation result and final verification report; check the target verdict separately from process success
